ethical_and_safety_notes: Output is a recommendation, never an action. Policy and the Safety Governor stand between this model and any device.
evaluation: Held-out final 5 days; mean absolute error 0.6 °C.
intended_use: Proposing a comfort setpoint for review. Advisory only.
limitations: Cold-starts for the first three weeks and after a household change. Suspended automatically when drift is detected.
out_of_scope_use: Any safety decision, any life-safety actuator, and any home other than the one it was trained on.
summary: Predicts the temperature this household chooses at this hour.
training_data: 21 days of this home's own thermostat changes. No data leaves the hub.
